claims.claim: Microsoft Xbox One S All-Digital Edition Console (Disc-free)
claims.evidence: Witness only confirms an Xbox logo on a white console; no disc-drive absence, model text, or rear panel is visible to distinguish All-Digital Edition from a standard Xbox One S.

claims.claim: Compact '40%' smaller form factor (Xbox One S generation)
claims.evidence: No size reference or comparison object in either photo to confirm form factor.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or function
risks.proof: Video clip of console powering on to dashboard

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power supply, HDMI cable, controller)
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory set laid out next to console
Photo of console settings screen or rear label showing storage size

risks.risk: Hidden damage on rear/sides, port condition
risks.proof: Photos of all sides including rear ports and bottom vents
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic condition unknown, assume wear

risks.risk: Model misidentification (All-Digital vs standard disc edition)
risks.proof: Clear photo of front/rear showing presence or absence of disc slot
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard Xbox One S (lower-spec assumption) until disc-free confirmed

risks.risk: No proof of original box or receipt, possible stolen/grey-market unit
risks.proof: Photo of box with serial number matching console, or purchase receipt

proof_requests: Video of console powering on and reaching home dashboard
Photo of rear panel showing all ports and serial/model number sticker
Photo of console settings screen showing storage capacity
Photo of all included accessories (power cable, HDMI, controller) laid out
Photo of front panel showing presence/absence of disc slot
Photo of original box or receipt if available
response.reason: The witness confirms a genuine Xbox console, so it can be priced, but the specific model, functionality, storage, and accessories are unconfirmed and must be priced at worst case until proven.
